full_judgment: 6. As against the judgment and decree of the lower appellate Court the contesting defendants moved the High Court Division in revisional jurisdiction. The High Court Division made the Rule absolute on the finding that by the kabala Ext. 3 Abdul Motalib and Rahima Khatun did not acquire any title in the land of S.A. Khatian No. 170, that although Ext. l (C.S. khatian) was prepared in the name of Aminuddin predecessor of the plaintiffs but the presumption of the correctness thereof rebutted from the defendants' side, that plaintiffs failed to prove their possession in the land in suit, that plaintiffs by competent and reliable witness have not been able to prove their basic document on the basis whereof they are claiming the land in suit, that from the plaintiffs' side no reliable evidence was brought on record to show that C.S. khatian was correctly prepared in the name of Aminuddin upon exclusion of his other brothers, that defendants have proved by reliable evidence that they are in possession of the land in suit.
